name: Cypress Bend

fees.note: $40 a night for a standard RV spur, $50 for a waterfront or pull-through spur, every spur with water and 20/30/50-amp electric. Seniors (62+) and disabled veterans get 20% off. Sabine River Authority's fee schedule effective May 1, 2025, read 2026-10-12.

source: https://srala-toledo.com/park/ ('Parks Fee Schedule', 'Effective May 1, 2025': Cypress Bend $40.00 / $50.00 a night Standard / Waterfront-Pull-thru), read 2026-10-12
